f3_program: observe(at("heating_plant.fuel.consumption.duration", "21_hours"), 21, "hour", source("In 21 hours"))
observe(at("heating_plant.fuel.consumed.volume", "21_hours"), 7, "liter", source("a heating plant consumes 7 liters of fuel"))

consume("fuel_consumption_21_hours", "heating_plant", at("heating_plant.fuel.volume", "current"), at("heating_plant.fuel.consumed.volume", "21_hours"), source("a heating plant consumes 7 liters of fuel"))

rate_relation(at("heating_plant.fuel.consumed.volume", "21_hours"), "heating_plant.fuel.consumption.rate", at("heating_plant.fuel.consumption.duration", "21_hours"), source("In 21 hours, a heating plant consumes 7 liters of fuel."))
observe(at("heating_plant.fuel.consumption.duration", "90_hours"), 90, "hour", source("in 90 hours"))

rate_relation(at("heating_plant.fuel.consumed.volume", "90_hours"), "heating_plant.fuel.consumption.rate", at("heating_plant.fuel.consumption.duration", "90_hours"), source("How much does it consume in 90 hours?"))
query("value", at("heating_plant.fuel.consumed.volume", "90_hours"))
assumptions: The consumption rate remains constant across the 21-hour and 90-hour periods.

f3_program: observe(at("convenience_store.chip_bags.sold.count", "month"), 100, "count", source("A convenience store sold 100 bags of chips in a month"))
observe(at("convenience_store.chip_bags.sold.count", "first_week"), 15, "count", source("In the first week, 15 bags of chips were sold"))

multiple(at("convenience_store.chip_bags.sold.count", "second_week"), at("convenience_store.chip_bags.sold.count", "first_week"), 3, source("In the second week, thrice as many bags of chips were sold"))

same(at("convenience_store.chip_bags.sold.count", "third_week"), at("convenience_store.chip_bags.sold.count", "fourth_week"), source("There was an equal number of chips sold in the third and fourth week"))

sum_relation(at("convenience_store.chip_bags.sold.count", "month"), at("convenience_store.chip_bags.sold.count", "first_week"), at("convenience_store.chip_bags.sold.count", "second_week"), at("convenience_store.chip_bags.sold.count", "third_week"), at("convenience_store.chip_bags.sold.count", "fourth_week"), source("A convenience store sold 100 bags of chips in a month. In the first week, 15 bags of chips were sold. In the second week, thrice as many bags of chips were sold. There was an equal number of chips sold in the third and fourth week."))
query("value", at("convenience_store.chip_bags.sold.count", "third_week"))
assumptions: The later word "chips" refers to bags of chips, and the four named weeks partition the stated monthly sales total.

f3_program: observe(at("company.machinery.units.count", "operation"), 3, "count", source("He operates three units of machinery"))
observe(at("company.machinery.unit.current", "running"), 40, "ampere", source("require a running current of 40A each"))

multiple(at("company.machinery.unit.minimum_current", "starting"), at("company.machinery.unit.current", "running"), 2, source("These appliances require at least twice their running current for starting"))

product_relation(at("company.transformer.minimum_current_load", "starting"), at("company.machinery.units.count", "operation"), at("company.machinery.unit.minimum_current", "starting"), source("He operates three units of machinery that require a running current of 40A each. These appliances require at least twice their running current for starting, and the transformer chosen must account for this."))
query("value", at("company.transformer.minimum_current_load", "starting"))
assumptions: The transformer must support all three machines at their minimum starting-current requirement; because the query asks for a minimum, "at least twice" is represented by its twice-running-current lower bound.

f3_program: collection("bryan.push_up_sets", "push_up_set", "home", source("at home during quarantine. To start, he decides to do 3 sets of 15 push-ups each"))
observe(at("bryan.push_up_sets.planned.count", "quarantine"), 3, "count", source("3 sets"))
observe(at("bryan.push_up_sets.planned.push_ups_each.count", "quarantine"), 15, "count", source("15 push-ups each"))

same(at("bryan.push_up_sets.first.completed_push_ups.count", "quarantine"), at("bryan.push_up_sets.planned.push_ups_each.count", "quarantine"), source("To start, he decides to do 3 sets of 15 push-ups each. Near the end of the third set, he gets tired and does 5 fewer push-ups."))

same(at("bryan.push_up_sets.second.completed_push_ups.count", "quarantine"), at("bryan.push_up_sets.planned.push_ups_each.count", "quarantine"), source("To start, he decides to do 3 sets of 15 push-ups each. Near the end of the third set, he gets tired and does 5 fewer push-ups."))

offset(at("bryan.push_up_sets.third.completed_push_ups.count", "quarantine"), at("bryan.push_up_sets.planned.push_ups_each.count", "quarantine"), -5, "count", source("Near the end of the third set, he gets tired and does 5 fewer push-ups"))

sum_relation(at("bryan.push_ups.total_completed.count", "quarantine"), at("bryan.push_up_sets.first.completed_push_ups.count", "quarantine"), at("bryan.push_up_sets.second.completed_push_ups.count", "quarantine"), at("bryan.push_up_sets.third.completed_push_ups.count", "quarantine"), source("To start, he decides to do 3 sets of 15 push-ups each. Near the end of the third set, he gets tired and does 5 fewer push-ups."))
query("value", at("bryan.push_ups.total_completed.count", "quarantine"))
assumptions: The five-fewer comparison is against the planned 15 push-ups for the third set, and the first two sets were completed as planned.
